sim_fifo_desc: First-In-First-Out: Oldest stock lot released first based purely on arrival order, ignoring expiration dates. Highest product waste.
sim_fefo_desc: First-Expiry-First-Out: Earliest expiration batch released without consumption velocity risk check. Reduces waste vs FIFO.
sim_fefoplus_desc: Enhanced FEFO: Earliest expiry prioritized + negative risk-margin batches automatically accelerated for release. Minimum waste.
